description: Get the garden state. Default: full payload (summary + zones + pins + objects + layer visibility + view mode + geo-anchor + coordinate system) — use at session start. Pass summary_only=true on large scenes to skip the heavy arrays and return just the summary block + coordinateSystem (avoids exceeding the tool-result token budget).

summary_only.description: When true, return only { summary, coordinateSystem }. Skips zones/pins/objects/gardenInfo/layerVisibility/viewMode/geoAnchor arrays. Recommended for scenes with many objects.

name: get_full_state
